The Ukrainian driver receives 24 months' imprisonment, a ten-year French territory ban, 131,605 euros in cumulative customs fines, as well as confiscation of the drugs, cash and seized material. The customs authority thus recalls, through this operation, the importance of controls carried out on transports circulating in the Hautes-Pyrenees.

report.body:
Authorities raided a luxury rental home in Bangkok, uncovering a massive illegal
cannabis operation. Immigration police and health officials seized over
five tons of marijuana buds from the property. Five foreign nationals were
arrested: one Vietnamese national and four workers from Myanmar. The
property was located in the Bang Khen district of Bangkok. Neighbors
complained about a strong, lingering smell of cannabis for weeks before alerting
authorities. The operation used a permit valid only for Nong Bua Lamphu
province, not Bangkok, violating Thai traditional medicine laws. Operating
without proper local authorization carries a penalty of up to one year in prison
or a fine of 20,000 baht. Police are sending the seized cannabis to a
laboratory for testing to determine if it was grown locally or illegally
imported. The Vietnamese man was suspected of managing daily operations
like a corporate supervisor. Myanmar laborers earned 200 to 300 baht per
day for their illegal work.
